title: Beyond Uniform Local Isometry and Topology: FactoMap for Disentangled Representations
abstract: arXiv:2608.24762v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many disentanglement methods represent generative factors using Euclidean product coordinates, although the underlying factor spaces may wrap, collapse, or have position-dependent geometry. We introduce factor-space structure, combining factor domains, generator-induced identifications, and position-dependent scales to distinguish topologically equivalent spaces with different factor geometries. We show that statistically independent factors need not be geometrically separable: hue and scale produce effects that grow at different rates, yielding anisotropy that no fixed rescaling removes. We propose the Factor-Space Topographic Map (FactoMap), which learns interpretable prototypes indexed by a factor-space lattice. Topographic learning transfers the lattice's periodicity, collapses, and non-uniform extent to the representation. translated_title: 超越均匀局部等距与拓扑：FactoMap用于解耦表示
translated_abstract: 许多解耦方法使用欧几里得乘积坐标来表示生成因子，尽管底层因子空间可能发生缠绕、坍缩或具有位置依赖的几何结构。我们引入了因子空间结构，结合因子域、生成器诱导的等价关系以及位置依赖的尺度，以区分具有不同因子几何但拓扑等价的空间。我们表明，统计独立的因子不需要在几何上可分离：色调和尺度产生的影响以不同速率增长，导致各向异性，且任何固定缩放都无法消除。我们提出了因子空间拓扑图（FactoMap），它学习由因子空间格点索引的可解释原型。拓扑学习将格点的周期性、坍缩和非均匀范围转移到表示中。实验表明，匹配这种结构能保持因子连续性，并实现解耦。
tldr: 本文提出FactoMap方法，通过引入因子空间结构并利用拓扑学习，解决了传统解耦方法中因子几何非均匀性问题，实现了对具有复杂几何的生成因子的有效解耦。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FactoMap, which leverages factor-space structure and topographic learning to address non-uniform geometry in disentangled representations, enabling effective disentanglement of generative factors with complex geometries.
